title: TCI Assessment
subtitle: Temperament and Character Inventory

questions.tci_1: My spirit is constantly drawn to the allure of the unknown and the new.
questions.tci_2: I find deep comfort in the rhythm of familiar routines.
questions.tci_3: Reflections on the shadows of the future often weigh heavy on my mind.
questions.tci_4: I walk with an innate optimism, trusting the light will guide me.
questions.tci_5: The warmth of recognition and praise feeds my heart.
questions.tci_6: I stand firm like a lone pine, indifferent to the winds of public opinion.
questions.tci_7: I endure the storms until my mission stands complete.
questions.tci_8: When the path becomes too thorny, I choose a new direction with ease.
questions.tci_9: I am the sovereign architect of my own destiny.
questions.tci_10: I often feel like a leaf drifting on the river of fate.
questions.tci_11: I see myself as a thread in the great tapestry of humanity.
questions.tci_12: In the garden of life, I tend to my own flowers first.
questions.tci_13: I sense a sacred resonance that binds all living things.
questions.tci_14: I trust only in the tangible world that I can touch and measure.

paradoxDesc: The interplay of {key} within your resonance.
